message: 謎が謎呼ぶ転校生

name: Synn
message: 「--And that's what happened.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My, my. That is a very intriguing story.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're a returnee too, right, Rolo-chan? How was it for you after moving over here?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was quite bewildered by many things at first, though everyone treated me so kindly that I made friends right away.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it is her first day... Guess it can't be helped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why not just take it slow and get along? We're in the same class for at least the rest of this school year, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Becoming good friends is a truly wonderful thing, I think.\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly wants to get closer to Ria-chan too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, no way, no how.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Hello.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Hello~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun. I've never seen that girl from lunchtime before--is she a transfer student?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yep, yep. We were just talking about her right now.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's our classmate.」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-chan. So she ended up in Synn-kun's class.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you know her, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Big Sis was making a huge fuss, going, 'Haha! Another cute girl just joined us!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「Make sure you escort her properly, okay? You're on the Student Council, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You look out for her too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course.」

name: Helena
message: 「Mm-hm, that's the spirit. Leaving things to the Student Council President really was the right call.」

name: Ria
message: 「Sis. Appearing out of nowhere is one thing, but you still have to greet everyone properly.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, my apologies.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahn, n-no, not again!! Jeez, I told you not to do that in front of everyone--\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She's at it again...\s03」

name: Ria
message: 「*Smack!!*」

name: Synn
message: 「M-M-Me?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah! That was just reflex... I'm so sorry!」

name: Helena
message: 「I can't blame Synn-chan for staring. Ria's boobs are the absolute best, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not it at all!\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Whaaat?! Looking at Senpai with such lewd eyes is u-u-unforgivable!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you really were looking at Senpai with pervy eyes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you, Nanaka?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are Senpai-san's boobs really the absolute best?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't put me on the spot by asking me that~」

name: Helena
message: 「No can do, though, Synn-chan. Ria's boobs belong to me, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「They don't belong to anybody!」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're all mine!」

name: Helena
message: 「More importantly, regarding the transfer student-Azel-chan.」

name: Helena
message: 「Since she came all alone to this academy from a faraway land, she doesn't have any relatives here, let alone acquaintances or friends.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mhm, mhm.」

name: Helena
message: 「She's moving into the dorms starting today, so she's bound to spend night after night drowning in loneliness and soaking her pillow with tears.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She didn't really strike me as that kind of girl, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, I went and asked the teachers if they could put her in the same class as you, Synn-chan, since you're the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「So that's how she ended up in my class.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She probably didn't ask nicely, she ordered it.」

name: Helena
message: 「Little Ms. Airhead. If you keep spouting tall tales, I'm going to shove a shotgun into that cute little mouth of yours and blow it away without mercy.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-no, please stop.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel and I had a lively, fun chat during lunch break.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh-ho. Well, good for you.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「W-why are you mad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not mad.\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, Mr. Panda. How did things actually go?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Watching the two of them interact was pretty entertaining.」

name: Ria
message: 「So it didn't look like they were having fun, then.\s02」

name: Helena
message: 「It seems you've been looking out for Azel in your own way. That's a relief. Keep getting along with her from now on, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, understood.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmm...」

name: Misa
message: 「Um, Helena! If that's the case, please let me help out too!」

name: Helena
message: 「My, aren't you saying the sweetest things.」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't leave taking care of a cute transfer student to some guy.」

name: Helena
message: 「Why not?」

name: Misa
message: 「Because if a boy and a girl get too close... well... impure relationships and all sorts of problems might...」

name: Helena
message: 「Hmm. Impure relationships? How intriguing. Care to explain the specifics to me?」

name: Misa
message: 「Eeh!? I-I-I couldn't possibly say something like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-it's something you can't even say?!」

name: Helena
message: 「Teehee. You should have just said from the start that you refuse to lose to Synn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-what.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're not being honest with yourself, Vice President.」

name: Misa
message: 「How many times do I have to tell you it's not like that!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo's right, you know. Just be honest and act like your usual self.」

name: Ria
message: 「'Let's see who can make friends with them first!!'--like that ♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Please stop making such tasteless jokes too, Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「She really has no self-awareness...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief. You're all talk and no action.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, I didn't say anything!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Which means it's time for me to step in!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When loneliness is shared, everyone is happy. Now then, let us go look for this transfer student.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I call it 'Operation Bright & Friendly'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, hey, wait up, Lolo--! I'm coming too--!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Misa-chan, Synn-kun. Since we're at it, why don't we all go say hello together? Don't you think we'll become friends right away if we do?」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, Ria, saying things like an innocent, pure little girl. Only your chest grew up, and it makes Big Sis so sad!」

name: Ria
message: 「*Smack!*」

name: Helena
message: 「Meanie--」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought we were already friends, though--」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggggh... Just this once, in deference to Senpai's kindness, I'll cooperate.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Bright Friend Plan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san...」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm going to make you regret saying I'm all talk!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh my~\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「It's settled, then. Well, excuse me for a moment--」
Ria-senpai suddenly closed the distance between us out of nowhere.
She smoothed and fixed my hair, stroking it with her fingers like a comb.
Then she pressed her body close against mine to check my appearance.

name: Ria
message: 「Look, your collar is crooked too.」
Aah, something soft just rubbed right against my elbow!?

name: Misa
message: 「S-Se-Senpai! Wh-Wh-Wha--what do you think you're doing!」

name: Ria
message: 「When greeting someone for the first time, first impressions are everything, you know.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Like I said, this isn't my first time meeting her though...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun!! Stop saying lewd things and get away from Senpai right this instant!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Next is Misa-chan's turn.」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「There, all done. Well then, I'll be heading off.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes. I'll be praying for your success.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah--!? Is this reality!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's go, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I know that already!」

name: Helena
message: 「However, that girl... I don't think things will go quite as easily as you all believe.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, where are you going? The dorms aren't that way, you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if she is in the dorms, I can't go inside, can I?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a girls' dorm where boys are strictly forbidden. Even if it's for Student Council duties, that would never be allowed. That's why this is my time to shine--」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I don't think that girl is in the dorms.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We can't find Azel anywhere--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thanks to our Treasurer, all that hard work went completely to waste.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if she doesn't have club activities, she'd go home, right!? And if she goes home, that means the dorms are the only place!」

name: Misa
message: 「So, she wasn't in the dorms... then?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's after school, so you've gotta enjoy it! I'm sure she's out exploring here and there.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, if she goes back to the dorms, there are lots of friends from other classes and grades, so I think she could have fun there too...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so~? That sounds fun~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「That's precisely why she isn't going back, I'm sure.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... why?」

name: Synn
message: 「It seems Azel doesn't like noisy places.」

name: Misa
message: 「Then she might be in the library, wouldn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「If she isn't here, that is.」
Just as expected, Azel was standing there all alone.
She wasn't offering a silent prayer, nor was she making a confession.
Within a silence like that of people eating crab, there was a tranquility no one could disturb.
Everyone was captivated by that mysterious, enigmatic atmosphere.
Save for just one person--

name: Lolotte
message: 「There she is!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, Loro-chan. I told you not to startle us!」
Azel doesn't even glance in our direction.

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, did she not notice?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, Jose.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe she noticed, and she's just pretending she didn't?」

name: Misa
message: 「Naturally. You called out to her on your very first meeting without even a proper greeting. Watch closely, I shall set an example for you.」
Saying so, Misa is the very first to step up to Azel.

name: Misa
message: 「Good day. I am Misa B. Cristelis of Class 2-B. Are you Azel-san?」

name: Misa
message: 「Since you only recently transferred here, you must still be unfamiliar with this school, correct?」

name: Misa
message: 「If you don't mind, might I have the pleasure of showing you around?」

name: Misa
message: 「The church here is really lovely, isn't it.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what kind of place the Principality of Sharo-Ma is? I'm very interested in it.」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey... what are your hobbies, or your favorite foods.」

name: Misa
message: 「Um... can you hear me?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's having a rough time of it.」

name: Synn
message: 「She's probably about to reach her boiling point...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, hurry up and show the cue card!」
'Hold it in!!'

name: Ria
message: 「Clench your teeth.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold it right in!」
Even after that, Misa undeterredly brings up various topics, yet Azel shows no reaction whatsoever.
Considering how close she is, she must be deliberately choosing to ignore her. Though why she's doing that is a mystery.
Perhaps having reached her boiling point, Misa turned on her heel and came back.

name: Misa
message: 「Just like Sakura-kun, I had a... pleasant chat with her.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... good work out there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You did great!! You really did great!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That competitive streak of hers is something else.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you talking about? You mustn't avert your eyes from reality. That was totally no good at all. Leave this part to me, please.」
Lolotte puffed out her chest and walked over.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Transfer student, nice to meet you! I'm Lolotte.」

name: Azel
message: 「An angel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek! What are you saying all of a sudden!? I am n-n-n-not an angel at all!」

name: Azel
message: 「Get lost.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--! How could you say something so awful!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Otherwise.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-Threats won't work on me!」

name: Azel
message: 「You'll disappear.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!!」
Sway, sway.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!」
I caught Lolotte's small body with a headfirst slide.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... You don't have to be so harsh with her, do you?」

name: Azel
message: 「You again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you refuse to get involved with people so much?」

name: Azel
message: 「Involved?」

name: Synn
message: 「We might be noisy and a bother, sure, but.」

name: Azel
message: 「You are a bother.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to say it so bluntly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W... Wait, please...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, are you okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, though I nearly returned to the heavens...」

name: Azel
message: 「Wise.」

name: Synn
message: 「There you go saying things like that again...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's alright. I'm sure the transfer student-no, Azel-san is just feeling bewildered.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She came all the way from a distant foreign land, after all. I think there are all sorts of differences, like culture and such. Surely, that's why--」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「See, I knew it!」

name: Azel
message: 「You must be different too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, at first every day was full of anxiety. But I read this guidebook and studied properly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Azel, stop being so stubborn. You should just kick back and have some fun.」

name: Azel
message: 「Have fun?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that's the spirit♪ You've gotta enjoy yourself! Youth only comes around once in a lifetime, you know!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Pointless.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tsk, tsk, tsk. Once you start thinking like that, you're officially a loser!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「By the way, do you like sweets?」

name: Azel
message: 「Sweets?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course you love 'em! So come on, come on, join the Sweets Club!」

name: Synn
message: 「I dunno about that--apparently Azel's trying to save money.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's not you, you know...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, sweets are just an excuse anyway. We're gonna be seeing each other almost every day from now on, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since we're all going to the same school, let's get along. And let's have fun together! Right, Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah! Right, right, a sparkling school life together--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「YEEEAAAH! You're totally gonna regret it if you don't enjoy yourself!」
I wish she'd at least give me a sneer or something.

name: Ria
message: 「I guess this is our first time meeting? I'm Ria Kujou, a third-year.」

name: Azel
message: 「Kujou?」

name: Ria
message: 「You've already met my big sister-Helena-haven't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Did Helena put you up to this?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... You figured it out after all? Even so, everyone on the Student Council genuinely wants to be friends with you, regardless of all that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you think we could become friends?」

name: Azel
message: 「No need.」

name: Ria
message: 「Now then... I wonder just how long that stubborn act of yours will last~?」

name: Ria
message: 「After all, you're surrounded by so many charming, wonderful girls.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're definitely going to end up wanting friends.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Senpai...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Just kidding. Ahahahaha--\s01」

name: Azel
message: 「Why?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」
In the middle of their heartwarming conversation, Azel's gaze was focused intently on Ria-senpai's ample chest.

name: Azel
message: 「Why are they big?」
Pressing both hands against her own chest, she occasionally looked back and forth to compare them.

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's... probably because I drink milk every day, maybe?」

name: Synn
message: 「See, milk really is good for the body!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Also 'cause they get groped a ton!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up, both of you!」

name: Azel
message: 「Mysterious, isn't it.」
Azel wore a blank expression that fit none of the usual emotions--neither joy, anger, sorrow, nor pleasure.
Until now, she had looked as though she were endlessly chewing flavorless gum, yet in that single moment, she seemed just a little different.
And everyone present was surely thinking the exact same thing.

name: Everyone
message: 「You're the most mysterious one here!」
In the end, the Student Council raised the white flag and withdrew.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah. Miss Shrine Maiden!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, Lolotte-dono. And if it isn't everyone from the Student Council as well.」

name: Misa
message: 「Good day, Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「A fine day to you. However, I see signs of weariness upon you. Your Student Council duties must be quite exhausting.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm completely worn out.」

name: Shio
message: 「I had intended to persuade Lolotte-dono to return to the Naginata Club, yet it seems you already have your hands full with the Student Council.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, things have been pretty hectic.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm. Then please head straight home tonight as well. I shall take care of exterminating the monsters myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh... don't tell me a demon appeared!?」

name: Shio
message: 「I sensed the presence of an apparition around here, yet...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I don't think that's the case, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Didn't you just react to this guy?」

name: Shio
message: 「What?! To be distracted by such a vulgar creature, what a blunder...!」
Hold on. If she can sense a demon's presence, what about me...?

name: Paqy
message: 「You're still a total fledgling, so you'll be fine.」
Am I ranked even lower than that chubby round demon?!
Still, it looks like Azel is the only one here besides us... Could she be an apparition--a demon too?

name: Shio
message: 「My devotion is lacking. I must train harder!」

name: Misa
message: 「Training is fine and all, but make sure you go to your club activities properly. They have high expectations for you, after all.」

name: Shio
message: 「Rest assured. I have already finished my club activities for the day.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, it's that late already?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah! I left Sacchin waiting!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, whatever. She'd just make me treat her anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like we'd better call it a day for today.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Agreed~」

name: Misa
message: 「Shion, let's walk home together.」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood, loud and clear.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Good work today.」
